transactionbodycustomfield.description: How much of this receipt's stock has been moved out of the on-hold bin into a good bin by an inventory_release call. Written by the RapidBridge inbound write RESTlet (§11.6) when it creates the Bin Transfer; never entered by hand. Together with Held Quantity this is what the "received but not released" worklist is built on: a receipt whose stock is never released fails silently - no call errored, the stock simply sits in the on-hold bin until a picker finds the good bin empty.
